name: toggle-group-08
description: Monthly versus yearly billing switch that updates the plan price and savings badge.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { ToggleGroup, ToggleGroupItem, } from "@workspace/ui/components/toggle-group" export default function BillingCycleToggleGroup() { const [cycle, setCycle] = React.useState("yearly") const price = cycle === "yearly" ? 16 : 20 return (
next[0] && setCycle(next[0])} > Monthly Yearly -20%

Team plan

${price} /seat/mo

{cycle === "yearly" ? "Billed $192 per seat annually" : "Billed monthly, cancel anytime"}

) }
